questions.stem: Consider the following about ISRO's CHANDRAYAAN-3 (2023). 1. It was launched by the LVM3-M4 rocket from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota. 2. The Vikram lander achieved a soft landing near the lunar south pole on 23 August 2023. 3. India became the first country to soft-land in the lunar south-polar region. 4. The Pragyan rover carried the APXS and LIBS instruments for on-surface chemistry. Which are correct?
questions.explanation: All four correct. Chandrayaan-3 launched 14 July 2023 on LVM3-M4. Vikram landed 23 Aug 2023 at Shiv Shakti Point near the south pole. India thus became 4th country to soft-land on Moon AND 1st to land in south-polar region. Pragyan carried APXS (Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer) + LIBS (Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy) for in-situ chemistry.

questions.stem: Match the SPACE MISSION with its PRIMARY objective. A. Aditya-L1. B. Mangalyaan. C. Chandrayaan-2. D. Gaganyaan. List-II: 1. Mars atmospheric and surface study. 2. Human spaceflight. 3. Solar observation at the Sun-Earth L1 point. 4. Lunar orbiter + lander + rover (lander lost).
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 — India's first dedicated solar observatory, launched Sep 2023 to the Sun-Earth Lagrange-1 point. Mangalyaan (MOM) — Mars orbiter, 2014 (cheapest-ever Mars mission). Chandrayaan-2 (2019) — orbiter still operational, but Vikram lander crashed on touchdown. Gaganyaan — India's crewed spaceflight programme (uncrewed test flights ongoing; first crewed target 2025-26).

questions.stem: Which of the following is the FIRST Indian-designed-and-built supercomputer under the National Supercomputing Mission?
questions.explanation: Under the National Supercomputing Mission, Param Shivay (installed at IIT-BHU, 2019) was the FIRST supercomputer assembled indigenously. Pratyush (at IITM Pune, 2018) and Mihir (at NCMRWF) are older meteorological supercomputers. SahasraT (at IISc) preceded NSM.

questions.stem: Consider the following about UPI (Unified Payments Interface). 1. UPI is developed and operated by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). 2. It uses a Virtual Payment Address (VPA) instead of exposing bank account details to the receiver. 3. UPI-Lite enables small-value offline transactions without requiring a PIN each time. 4. UPI is now accepted in multiple foreign countries through bilateral agreements with their payment systems. Which are correct?
questions.explanation: All four correct. NPCI operates UPI (launched 2016). VPA (like name@bank) abstracts bank details. UPI-Lite (2022) permits low-value offline transactions. UPI is now live in France, Sri Lanka, Mauritius, UAE, Singapore, Bhutan, Nepal (via bilateral agreements) with more in the pipeline.

questions.stem: ASSERTION (A): A quantum computer with N qubits can represent 2^N quantum states simultaneously via superposition. REASON (R): A classical computer with N bits can represent only ONE of 2^N possible states at any given time.

options.option_text: Both A and R are true, R is the correct explanation
Both A and R are true, but R EXPLAINS the DIFFERENCE, not A directly
A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true

questions.explanation: Both statements are TRUE. But R describes the classical-computer situation, while A describes the quantum-computer capability. R is not an EXPLANATION of A — it's the CONTRAST that makes quantum interesting. Subtle A-R pairing a well-prepared student will catch.

questions.stem: Which of the following was NOT a significant Indian space mission?

options.option_text: SSLV-D2 (small satellite launch vehicle, first successful mission Feb 2023)

questions.explanation: BharatNet is a TERRESTRIAL fibre-optic broadband programme (under Universal Service Obligation Fund, aimed at connecting every gram panchayat), NOT a satellite mission or a space-vehicle. The other three are genuine ISRO missions.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a feature of 5G compared to 4G/LTE?

options.option_text: Reduced power consumption on the handset (5G always consumes less than 4G)
Support for massive IoT via ultra-high device density per cell

questions.explanation: 5G does NOT always consume less power than 4G — handset power draw can actually be higher in mmWave 5G modes. The other three are headline 5G features: multi-Gbps peaks, sub-10 ms latency, million-devices-per-km² density target.

questions.stem: CERN's Large Hadron Collider is famous for confirming the existence of the:
questions.explanation: Announced 4 July 2012 at CERN (ATLAS + CMS experiments). Peter Higgs and François Englert shared the 2013 Physics Nobel for the theoretical prediction. Gravitational waves were detected by LIGO, not CERN; dark matter remains undiscovered. A Higgs boson confirms the mechanism by which particles acquire mass.
